grammarRule.formula: Since + starting point of time | For + duration/period of time

explanation.ml: ഒരു കാര്യം തുടങ്ങിയ നിർദ്ദിഷ്ട സമയം (2018, Monday, morning) പറയാൻ 'Since' ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു. ആകെ എത്ര സമയം (3 hours, 5 years, 2 weeks) നീണ്ടുനിന്നു എന്ന് പറയാൻ 'For' ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു.
explanation.en: Master Duration: Since vs For with clear formula: Since + starting point of time | For + duration/period of time

goldenTip.ml: 💡 ടിപ്പ്: Point in time = Since (Since 9 AM). Length of time = For (For 4 hours).
goldenTip.en: Golden Tip: Point in time = Since (Since 9 AM). Length of time = For (For 4 hours).

nouns.definition: Having existed or done something for a long time and therefore recognized and generally accepted.

nouns.definition: Devoted to a task or purpose.

nouns.definition: Continuing for an extended period or without interruption.
nouns.example: The renewable energy farm has maintained sustained power output throughout storm season.

traps.question: Fill in the blank: 'I have been studying English _____ three months.'
traps.explanationMl: 'three months' എന്നത് ഒരു കാലയളവ് (duration) ആയതിനാൽ 'for' ഉപയോഗിക്കണം ('for three months').

traps.question: Fill in the blank: 'She has lived in London _____ 2018.'
traps.explanationMl: '2018' എന്നത് ഒരു പ്രത്യേക വർഷം/തുടക്ക ബിന്ദു (point in time) ആയതിനാൽ 'since' ഉപയോഗിക്കണം ('since 2018').

traps.question: Which sentence correctly pairs the preposition with the time expression?
options: He has been waiting since four hours.
He has been waiting for four hours.
He has been waiting for yesterday morning.
He has been waiting since two weeks.
traps.explanationMl: 'four hours' കാലയളവായതിനാൽ 'for' ആണ് ശരി ('for four hours').
